info.title: ЖерБақылау API
info.description:
Цифровой мониторинг земель: панель инспектора, «Народный контроль» и статусы заявлений.

Ошибки возвращаются в формате `{error: {code, message, details}}`.

get.summary: Which login flow the web panel must use
Search by cadastral number or address

schema.title: Response Search Parcels Api V1 Parcels Search Get

post.summary: Upload inspector photos (multipart, up to 10 files)

get.summary: Reconcile with the state cadastre registry (ГБД ЗКС adapter, demo)
Inspection act (PDF) in the interface language
NDVI history (up to 3 years) and before/after satellite images; built in the background on first request
Signals queue (open first, newest on top)

post.summary: Take into work / confirm (parcel → VIOLATION) / reject; the citizen is notified
Change application status with RU/KZ explanation; subscribers get a Telegram push
Ask the owner for a photo report (returns the one-time link)
Accept or reject an owner photo report (a FAILED report cannot be accepted)

post.summary: Create owner photo-report requests: top risk + reproducible random control sample

get.summary: What evidence exists to close the violation as resolved
Cross-check with state data: cadastre registry, declared sowing (subsidies) vs satellite
NDVI layer (Sentinel-2 L2A or demo provider)

post.summary: Start a satellite scan in the background (result arrives as a satellite.scan_completed event)

get.summary: Verify a printed act by its QR code

Create a signal exactly as the bot would (for e2e tests and demo fallback)
Wipe domain data and re-seed the demo
